text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown,
the Satsuki Sho, had finally arrived.

With the "Big Three" clashing head-to-head,
the world was buzzing with excitement. Everyone's eyes were on who would emerge victorious.

However—in the shadow of all that excitement,
a small incident was unfolding.

"At this rate, we wouldn't make it to the venue in time,
so I hurriedly went searching for her. Just then—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyan nyan, kitty-cat nyan~.
Good little kitty, hold that pose right there♪

Seiun Sky was leisurely playing with a cat
in the park...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Just the person I was looking for~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, get the camera ready~
Please take a picture of me and the kitty.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry, hurry!
We're out of time! Make it quick!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okay, peace nyaan.

Without really understanding what was happening,
I took a picture of the cat and Seiun Sky,
then sent the data to her smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And now, to send this photo... Sent!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, all good.
Well then, shall we go~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I don't mind chatting, but getting scratched for being late would kinda suck~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, follow Sei-chan!
Full-power spri~nt!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whew, made it just in time, just in time♪
Actually, didn't we even have a tiny bit of room to spare?
choice_data_list: Thank goodness I made it in time...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aha, sorry for keeping you on edge, okay?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, this is nowhere near everything I've got.
I'll make the race waaaay more thrilling for you☆”
choice_data_list: What do you think you're doing!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, why are you cowering?
I wouldn't mess around like that, come on~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Because it's the first leg of the Classics, right?
...Personally, I have a bit of a sentimental attachment to it too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —I have no intention of letting anyone else take my marked prey.

Despite the unexpectedly hectic pre-race commotion,
Seiun Sky remained remarkably composed.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, just sit back and take it easy.
I won't do ya wrong♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Sky-san... Did I hear correctly
that you arrived at the venue at the very last minute?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, can you really fight properly like that?
Show some sense of urgency—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: King.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're worried about me, aren't you?
As expected of King, you're so kind~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, focus on yourself instead of me. Today's
race looks like it won't be a walk in the park.”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I might not let you pass anyway, you know?
Let's both do our best~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...What's that supposed to mean? I'm totally serious.
And so is Sky-sanâ

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew... Alright!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The very first step to becoming the number one Umamusume in Japan.
Let's run through it with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —So Special Week only looks straight ahead too, huh.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Very well. That is precisely why you are worthy of the 'Big Three.'
You shall serve as nourishment for my first-rate growth...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Grandpa.
I finally made it this far.
Well, don't get your hopes up too high—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"—Wait for me to bring back the crown♪
From Sky☆"
